docs.summary: A punctual light defined by the source file (glTF `KHR_lights_punctual`). Position and orientation come from the [`ModelNode`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ModelNode) that references it.
docs.remarks:
A directional or spot light aims down its node's -Z, the same as a [`Camera`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Camera).

[`Intensity`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Light~Intensity) is carried in the source's photometric units, which are lux for directional lights and candela for point and spot. Engines that use an arbitrary intensity scale will want to rescale it rather than take it literally.

docs.summary: Light name, or `null` when the source did not name it.

docs.summary: Which kind of light this is.
Linear RGB colour. Alpha is unused and always 1.
Brightness in lux (directional) or candela (point and spot).
Distance at which the light stops contributing, or `null` for unlimited. Point and spot only; a directional light has no range.
Angle in radians from the cone axis where falloff begins. Spot only.
Angle in radians from the cone axis where the light reaches zero. Spot only.
